The '''Pirates of Prexiar''', also known as the '''Prexian pirates''', were an infamous [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group. They were led by the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Vangar]], and were based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prexiar]].<ref name="Pirates" />
